name: Mrs. Knott's Chicken-To-Go: Roasted or Fried Chicken Bucket, Pint of Mashed Potatoes, Soup & Hot Biscuits
brandOrRestaurant: Mrs. Knott's Chicken-To-Go (California Marketplace · Knott's Berry Farm)
whyItWorks: Skip the 90-minute sit-down wait at Mrs. Knott's: the dedicated **Chicken-To-Go** counter right next door lets you walk up and buy individual pieces of Roasted or Fried Chicken, a quart of Homemade Chicken Noodle Soup, Mashed Potatoes, and a half-dozen hot Buttermilk Biscuits with seedless Boysenberry Jelly in 5 minutes!
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Roasted Chicken pieces (or peel the breading off the Fried Chicken), a pint of Mashed Potatoes (gravy on the side), Chicken Noodle Soup, and hot Buttermilk Biscuits to eat at the outdoor patio or take back to your hotel.
watchOuts: Ask for gravy on the side and take a lactase tablet for the mashed potatoes and biscuits
